title: Hashtag Input
summary: Catches hashtags that quietly break, such as #don't posting as #don, and posts over a platform's tag limit.
description: Hashtag field that flags characters ending a tag early (spaces, apostrophes), all-digit tags that never link, case-only duplicates, banned tags and posts over a platform's limit, and suggests CamelCase (#OpenSource) so screen readers say the words. One-tap fixes.
catches: Space, apostrophe or punctuation that cuts a tag short
Duplicates that differ only by case
More tags than a platform allows or recommends (Instagram: 5 per post or Reel)
All-lowercase multi-word tags, with a CamelCase suggestion
limits: CamelCase split uses a small built-in word list; extend it with the words prop
Platform limits are baked in and change; pass your own platforms
Does not check whether a tag is shadow-banned or trending
a11y: Visible label tied to the input; Enter or comma adds a tag, Backspace on an empty field removes the last
Each remove button has an aria-label naming the tag
Issues are in a polite live region; icons are aria-hidden
Animation is skipped under reduced motion

sources.label: Instagram @creators: up to 5 hashtags per reel or post (18 Dec 2025)

rules.note: Informational; platform limits change. Only the Instagram limit was checked; LinkedIn and X counts are recommendations and were not re-verified.

stops: Helps catch a hashtag cut short by a space
